spans.s:
Straight metaphorically, as in morals, upright, honest.
E.
ऋज to go, affix कु.

m. (-यः)
A name of the saint KAŚYAPA.
E.
ऋजु straight, काय body.

f. (-ता)
1 Uprightness, sincerity.
2 Straightness.
E.
ऋजु with तल् affix; also with त्व, ऋजुत्वं.

n. (-णं)
Straightening.
E.
ऋजु and करण making; the vowel lengthened.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made straight.
E.
ऋजू and कृत made; the vowel lengthened.
